Northwind Tooling

Northwind Tooling is a precision tooling manufacturer that supplies machined components to aerospace and motorsport suppliers across the United Kingdom. Northwind Tooling was founded in 1998 and operates from Manchester.

What does Northwind Tooling make?

Northwind Tooling makes precision jigs, fixtures and machined components to tolerances of five microns. Northwind Tooling serves aerospace, motorsport and medical device manufacturers.

How do I place an order with Northwind?

Northwind Tooling accepts orders by email with a drawing attached. Northwind Tooling returns a quote within two working days. Contact us to get a quote.

Where is Northwind Tooling based?

Northwind Tooling is based in Manchester, United Kingdom, and ships across Europe. Northwind Tooling holds AS9100 certification for aerospace work.
